title: Baryon Asymmetry
description: For every billion antibaryons in the early universe there were a billion and one baryons. We are the one. Unlocks the Baryogenesis Seed.

puzzle.goal: In the early universe there were slightly more baryons than antibaryons. Measure the surplus per photon: divide the net baryon number density by the photon number density, which is the occupation of thermal photon modes (two polarisations, Bose statistics) at temperature T integrated over all wavenumbers k.
puzzle.name: Baryon-to-photon ratio
puzzle.ask: The photon integral gives nγ = (2ζ(3)/π²)(kB T/ħc)³ with ζ(3) = 1.202. Find η, in units of 10⁻¹⁰, today.
puzzle.method: Count photons by integrating the Bose occupation over all modes, 4πk²dk/(2π)³ per polarisation.
